_comment: Oracle task: is this tool call (name + arguments) a break-glass / emergency access that bypasses the normal access controls? Used by examples/oracle_regex_replacement (replaces the BREAKGLASS_RX pre-filter of T3-012). Prototypes are generic; evaluation texts live in the example's tests, not here.

break_glass: bypass the normal access controls in an emergency
use emergency privileges to open a restricted record
urgent override of the permission check
routine: a normal request handled with standard permissions

question:

override access that bypasses or elevates the normal access controls or permissions (in any language).
Mentions of glass, emergencies or contacts that do not bypass access controls are routine. A call that says it
does NOT use emergency or override access is routine.
Answer with exactly one word from: {labels}
